verdict.rationale: Logseq docs describe a local HTTP API server explicitly built 'to support external access to the database through authorization' and a plugin API for programmatic interaction with the graph (logseq-docs-6, logseq-docs-13, logseq-docs-21, logseq-docs-12), suggesting broad UI-parity access. However, no OpenAPI/spec exists (logseq-probe-1, logseq-probe-2) to confirm full coverage, and a hands-on user reports that in the newer DB version they can no longer use AI tools (Claude/codex) to write or update pages as they previously could via the API — calling it 'a real deal breaker' (logseq-comm-11), directly contradicting the claim of consistent API-driven control equal to the UI. missing for 10: documented API reference/OpenAPI spec proving full feature parity, evidence that AI-agent write access works reliably in the current (DB) version, and no regression reports.
